reason: The wedding is a few months away and I have no time to chase painters, so a signed finish date, one coordinator on WhatsApp and paying 70% only after I check the work is what I need. ₹89,000 for the whole house inside and out is fine if it means I don't have to manage anyone.
objection: They are new in Kochi, so if they take on too many homes the crew may still vanish halfway, and ₹2,000 a day off means nothing if the house is half-painted when the relatives arrive.
would_change_my_mind: If at the site visit they won't sign a finish date at least two weeks before the wedding, or can't show me a home they've already finished in Kochi, I'll go elsewhere.
